findings.finding_id: whole::part 1 ships without the pr open mint
findings.title: Part 1 ships without the pr open mint
findings.action: Land the mint as part 2 and keep FAFF-1476 open.
findings.disposition_rationale: The split into two PRs was chosen by the operator because the base-commit validator rejects an anchor carrying the new event type before main knows it. The mint ships as part 2; FAFF-1476 stays open until it merges.

occurrences.title: Part 1 ships without the pr open mint
